name: duckdb_sql
description:
Runs one read-only SQL statement with DuckDB over the customers, orders and products tables, loaded from customers.csv, orders.csv and products.csv in the DuckDB data folder (data.duckdb.dir) into a sandbox with no file or URL access. Files are read once, at start-up.
Returns {success, columns, data, row_count, sql, execution_time_ms, tables_available}; floats are rounded to 2 decimals. On failure {success: false, error, sql}.
Inputs (* required): sql* (one SELECT, WITH, FROM or EXPLAIN statement), limit (1-1000; default 100; appended when the query has no LIMIT).
For every file in the folder, larger limits and automatic reload use duckdb_query.
Example: {"sql": "SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_segment"}

sql.description: SQL query to execute. Use table names: customers, orders, products

examples.sql: SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_segment

schema_info.customers: customer_id, customer_name, email, country, region, city, customer_segment, customer_tier, signup_date, age_group, gender, acquisition_channel, is_active
schema_info.orders: order_id, customer_id, order_date, product_category, product_name, quantity, unit_price, discount_pct, shipping_cost, payment_method, order_status, region, sales_rep
schema_info.products: product_id, product_name, product_category, unit_cost, unit_price, supplier, stock_quantity, reorder_point

input.sql: SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(*) as count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_segment ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct/100.0)), 2) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.customer_name, c.customer_tier, ROUND(SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price), 2) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_tier ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT product_category, COUNT(*) as orders, SUM(quantity) as units_sold, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) as month, COUNT(*) as orders, ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
